## Expenses by Vendor

Cost of goods and expenses by vendor over a period: the lines on those accounts, grouped by the vendor or payee of the document they came from. It takes the cash basis and a comparison.

```ts
import { SalesByCustomer, SalesByItem, ExpensesByVendor, GeneralLedger, PostingsReport } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-report-library';
```

### Example
`Reports/expenses-by-vendor-2026`.
attributes.cardDescription: Cost of goods and expenses by vendor for a period.
